stories.title: Bangladesh garment workers clash with police as pay protests shut factories
stories.summary: Garment workers in Bangladesh clashed with police on Tuesday as protests over wages shut factories, escalating a standoff with employers over a new pay scale. The sector is the country main export earner and employs millions.

stories.title: Israel approves flydubai return to Tel Aviv pending security clearance
stories.summary: Israel approved flydubai resuming flights to Tel Aviv subject to a security clearance, a step toward restoring a Gulf carrier link that was disrupted by regional conflict. The airline had diverted a flight to Saudi Arabia earlier after an emergency signal.

stories.title: Israeli airstrike kills senior Hamas security official in Gaza, sources say
stories.summary: An Israeli airstrike killed a senior Hamas security official in Gaza, according to Hamas sources, in one of the first targeted killings reported since the latest ceasefire strain. Israel did not immediately comment.

stories.title: Sheikh Hasina seeks return to Bangladesh on December 16
stories.summary: Deposed Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina wants to fly home from India on December 16 aboard the state carrier, a plan Dhaka calls contentious as it weighs the political fallout of her return. She has been in exile since being ousted in 2024.

stories.title: Anthropic breaks below $83 IPO price as debut rally unravels
stories.summary: Anthropic shares fell below their $83 IPO price on Tuesday, erasing the gains from a strong first-day pop and putting pressure on the AI sector valuations that underpinned the listing. The reversal came amid a broader risk-off move in AI stocks.

stories.title: Nvidia slips as investors weigh risks around Huang return as CEO
stories.summary: Nvidia shares slipped as investors refocused on the political and governance risks surrounding Jensen Huang return as CEO after a presidential intervention. Analysts flagged board independence and Washington scrutiny as overhangs.

stories.title: Xiaomi third-quarter profit falls 57% as EV sales decline
stories.summary: Xiaomi reported a 57% drop in third-quarter profit, pressured by weaker electric vehicle deliveries alongside a softer smartphone market. The result clouds its bet that the EV unit can become a second growth engine.

stories.title: SpaceX and Tesla tap five directors to guide merger talks
stories.summary: SpaceX and Tesla have appointed five directors to steer talks over a potential combination, according to the Financial Times. The move signals formal groundwork for a deal that would reshape both Elon Musk companies.

stories.title: Four bold Browns predictions for the playoff push
stories.summary: Dawg Pound Daily laid out stretch-run calls for the 6-4 Browns: Jared Verse averaging a sack per game after a zero-sack first half, both rookie receivers topping 1,000 yards, Harold Fannin Jr. leading the team in catches and Cleveland winning a playoff game.

stories.title: Former Browns check-in: Garrett settles in, Newsome injured
stories.summary: A roundup of ex-Cleveland players shows Myles Garrett, traded to the Rams in June, posting three sacks in limited snaps, while Greg Newsome II suffered a high-ankle sprain days after signing a Giants extension. The piece credits GM Andrew Berry roster overhaul for a 6-4 start.

stories.title: Skull Session: Buckeyes lean on history before Michigan
stories.summary: Eleven Warriors opens rivalry week with Tennyson and the 2004 upset of Michigan as reminders that a disappointing season need not define what comes next. Ohio State is 7-4 and needs a win Saturday to salvage its Big Ten and playoff hopes.

stories.title: PFF grades: Jeremiah Smith, Luke Fahey top Buckeyes vs Nebraska
stories.summary: Jeremiah Smith and Luke Fahey were Ohio State top-graded players in the 31-28 loss to Nebraska, but only four other Buckeyes graded above 70. The numbers reflect a thin performance on both sides in the fourth loss of the season.

stories.title: Ryan Day: Focus on Michigan, not the 7-4 record
stories.summary: Ryan Day said Ohio State cannot afford to dwell on its record with Michigan next, calling the margin for error tiny against one of the top defenses in the nation. The Buckeyes close the regular season Saturday in Ann Arbor.

stories.title: Ferrari boss calls Leclerc-Hamilton pairing unmanageable
stories.summary: Fred Vasseur admitted the Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton partnership has become unmanageable after their latest collision in Las Vegas and hinted at regret over pairing them. Ferrari is weighing how to handle the two drivers over the final two rounds.

stories.title: Hamilton says No.1 status would have boosted eighth-title bid
stories.summary: Lewis Hamilton said he believes he could have won a record eighth world championship this season had Ferrari prioritised him over Leclerc. The comment sharpens questions about team orders after the pair collided again in Las Vegas.

stories.title: Qatar Grand Prix preview: start time, schedule and what is left to fight for
stories.summary: F1 heads to Lusail for the penultimate round on Nov. 29, the second leg of the final triple header. Kimi Antonelli has already sealed the title and Mercedes the constructors crown, leaving the fight for second and third as the main storyline.

stories.title: Verstappen-Russell feud unlikely to stay in Las Vegas
stories.summary: Max Verstappen mocked George Russell after the Las Vegas Grand Prix, calling the Mercedes driver 2026 campaign a complete joke, and ESPN expects the spat to carry into Qatar. The two have traded barbs for years and now meet again with little to lose in the standings.

stories.title: Escape from Tarkov 1.3.5.0 rolls out with Unity 6 and faster reconnects
stories.summary: Battlestate released patch 1.3.5.0, moving the game to Unity 6 and reworking raid loading, server performance and reconnect logic so dropped players can rejoin without reloading the raid. The patch also ends the Halloween event and introduces the RenderStack graphics platform.

stories.title: Thanksgiving 2026: no mail, shifted trash pickup, closures
stories.summary: Columbus will skip Thursday trash collection on Nov. 26 and shift color-coded pickups forward a day, while postal carriers, Columbus libraries and the Columbus Zoo close for the holiday. FedEx runs modified service Friday.

stories.title: One dead, one injured in Licking County crash
stories.summary: A 69-year-old woman was killed and another person injured in a two-vehicle crash Monday afternoon near Granville, according to the Ohio State Highway Patrol. Troopers responded at about 3:17 p.m.

stories.title: Columbus council pauses water and power rate increase vote
stories.summary: Columbus City Council postponed a vote on raising water and electricity rates for residents, with members still weighing funding to house people at a homeless encampment. The delay pushes the decision past the Thanksgiving holiday.
